newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa cargo stable in competitive mart.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa cargo stable in competitive mart.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it stabilised its business in September with a 1.4 percentage point improvement in its freight load factor to 69.1 percent but remains under strong market pressure.

"The volume growth in freight business was also satisfactory in September. The situation on the air cargo market, which is characterised by over-capacity and price pressure, has, however, not fundamentally changed." it said in latest monthly investor relations report.
The September improvement left the load factor so far this year only a small 0.3 percentage points down on last year at 67.9 percent.
